Well, Miss Mary Jane she told me to tell you she’s gone over there in a dreadful hurry—one of them’s sick.”"}, {"id": "043-031-0062", "tag": "p", "text": "“Which one?”", "sha256": "6ef2edeb1d6ebbab317205582bb72dbb6d6a7793c46516ee8e331da107563943", "source_location": "div.chapter[33]/*[62]", "source_html": "“Which one?”"}, {"id": "043-031-0063", "tag": "p", "text": "“I don’t know; leastways, I kinder forget; but I thinks it’s—”", "sha256": "75e5a2317d7c465eb8cfd385b78af6f1520218fa335fed1e8e148c20e907d655", "source_location": "div.chapter[33]/*[63]", "source_html": "“I don’t know; leastways, I kinder forget; but I thinks it’s—”"}, {"id": "043-031-0064", "tag": "p", "text": "“Sakes alive, I hope it ain’t Hanner?”", "sha256": "06b50537f0ca3cbc48df6ce79346d75b3a0e69b535647afafdbcf1681702eaac", "source_location": "div.chapter[33]/*[64]", "source_html": "“Sakes alive, I hope it ain’t Hanner?”"}, {"id": "043-031-0065", "tag": "p", "text": "“I’m sorry to say it,” I says, “but Hanner’s the very one.”", "sha256": "458a232a0dd18c0ffab8d8b13d24232776cc08fc81128caee7801ff8df83e6b3", "source_location": "div.chapter[33]/*[65]", "source_html": "“I’m sorry to say it,” I says, “but Hanner’s the very one.”"}, {"id": "043-031-0066", "tag": "p", "text": "“My goodness, and she so well only last week! Is she took bad?”", "sha256": "6b33bad5f5fddd3f9be0de2d82b11265211c6de25130c63953775421d0eb9e98", "source_location": "div.chapter[33]/*[66]", "source_html": "“My goodness, and she so well only last week! Is she took bad?”"}, {"id": "043-031-0067", "tag": "p", "text": "“It ain’t no name for it. They set up with her all night, Miss Mary Jane said, and they don’t think she’ll last many hours.”"}, {"id": "043-031-0068", "tag": "p", "text": "“Only think of that, now! What’s the matter with her?”"}, {"id": "043-031-0069", "tag": "p", "text": "I couldn’t think of anything reasonable, right off that way, so I says:", "sha256": "65cda8fd5e5f8f255244995452cd96c66396d7a2cec233caad286ec119d0163c", "source_location": "div.chapter[33]/*[69]", "source_html": "I couldn’t think of anything reasonable, right off that way, so I says:"}, {"id": "043-031-0070", "tag": "p", "text": "“Mumps.”", "sha256": "58e5a855953263bdca2aa645bc4efb6b4d163558131874d91cc0d3f179692325", "source_location": "div.chapter[33]/*[70]", "source_html": "“Mumps.”"}, {"id": "043-031-0071", "tag": "p", "text": "“Mumps your granny! They don’t set up with people that’s got the mumps.”"}, {"id": "043-031-0072", "tag": "p", "text": "“They don’t, don’t they? You better bet they do with these mumps. These mumps is different. It’s a new kind, Miss Mary Jane said.”"}, {"id": "043-031-0073", "tag": "source_caption", "text": "Hannah with the Mumps", "sha256": "abec58e202008b0e2acdf4be94780f78115332402127e3bacb6dd77b2ba29cb5", "source_location": "illustration-index/#c28-246", "image_id": "c28-246"}, {"id": "043-031-0074", "tag": "p", "text": "“How’s it a new kind?”", "sha256": "693ac8ad29598d631729659148d3fb1ffae215754f2bcd2756d9c1d42cbd9e93", "source_location": "div.chapter[33]/*[74]", "source_html": "“How’s it a new kind?”"}, {"id": "043-031-0075", "tag": "p", "text": "“Because it’s mixed up with other things.”", "sha256": "479eb867d3e74252c98b363c7220653506b6b8c6723564895486145c5772d6e4", "source_location": "div.chapter[33]/*[75]", "source_html": "“Because it’s mixed up with other things.”"}, {"id": "043-031-0076", "tag": "p", "text": "“What other things?”", "sha256": "ba7a1cb1d4582318ff84520bdbf0bf8b27e1ce16b0b26bbb70c7451e9ff0f63d", "source_location": "div.chapter[33]/*[76]", "source_html": "“What other things?”"}, {"id": "043-031-0077", "tag": "p", "text": "“Well, measles, and whooping-cough, and erysiplas, and consumption, and yaller janders, and brain-fever, and I don’t know what all.”", "sha256": "57ed10eb170a95a13a4935fd8240ea2c533829ff4010309fe7914744ac21a804", "source_location": "div.chapter[33]/*[77]", "source_html": "“Well, measles, and whooping-cough, and erysiplas, and consumption, and yaller janders, and brain-fever, and I don’t know what all.”"}, {"id": "043-031-0078", "tag": "p", "text": "“My land! And they call it the mumps?”", "sha256": "f2a659a3768e8afc3b096e93c41d13099aef61eb0b8c87810985c8ed0067c5b5", "source_location": "div.chapter[33]/*[78]", "source_html": "“My land! And they call it the mumps?”"}, {"id": "043-031-0079", "tag": "p", "text": "“That’s what Miss Mary Jane said.”", "sha256": "ce2a49f8b87f8c957a811a2e8e55afcc2a3433044597ddddf3d1765a8764c77c", "source_location": "div.chapter[33]/*[79]", "source_html": "“That’s what Miss Mary Jane said.”"}], "draft_rows": [{"source_id": "043-031-0060", "target": "«Их несколько, но в основном это Прокторы».", "source_sha256": "029d669b62569e5eb3d0ebc449fd47c6cd3578d5da83165048d5ff388deedcbb", "target_id": "ru-043-031-0060", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "adeb5c106f7ad2044f20ae3053855aaecf485a575b4bfd46c8141b3e94539018"}, {"source_id": "043-031-0061", "target": "«Вот как их зовут», — говорю я; «чуть не забыл.
